sloka: सो ऽपि त्वया हतस्तात रिपुणा भ्रातृगृध्नुना ।त्वया ऽस्मि निहता राजन्स्वयमेव हि बन्धुना ।। ७.२४.२९ ॥
transliteration: so 'pi tvayā hatastāta ripuṇā bhrātṛgṛdhnunā ।tvayā 'smi nihatā rājansvayameva hi bandhunā ।। 7.24.29 ॥

translations.english: O dear one, even he was killed by you, an enemy hostile to your own kin; O king, I myself have certainly been destroyed by you, my own kinsman.
